parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence; the former sodomy statute was repealed in 2023 and was rarely enforced even before, with no documented use against gender-diverse people. No traveler-facing restrictions appear in the record: no facility bans, no border/document friction, no police targeting of trans people, and the sole trans-specific incident documented is a 2016 harassment report. The state shows protective capacity (police protected Pride, PM supported an LGBTQ sit-in) though 2018 death threats and 2024 election hate speech show real social hostility, not mere friction. Absent legal gender recognition and missing gender-identity discrimination cover are resident gaps, not visitor exposures. Open questions (custody placement, border marker practice, HRT access, discrimination in public hospitals) and documented extremist threats hold it below 0.75; repeal plus moderate-to-growing acceptance plus no documented targeting places it in reduced risk around 0.68.
